title.zh: U.S. Spot Ethereum ETFs Hit Record 23-Day Net Outflow Streak Since Launch
title.en: U.S. Spot Ethereum ETFs Hit Record 23-Day Net Outflow Streak Since Launch

current_state.zh: Glassnode reported that U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs posted 23 consecutive trading days of net outflows, their longest streak since launch, indicating weakening traditional-finance demand after heavy ETH accumulation in August and September.
current_state.en: Glassnode reported that U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs posted 23 consecutive trading days of net outflows, their longest streak since launch, indicating weakening traditional-finance demand after heavy ETH accumulation in August and September.

updates.title_zh: 美国现货以太坊ETF创下自推出以来最长的23个交易日连续净流出纪录
updates.title_en: U.S. Spot Ethereum ETFs Hit Record 23-Day Net Outflow Streak Since Launch
updates.what_changed_zh:
Glassnode 报告称，美国现货以太坊ETF已连续23个交易日出现净流出，创下这类基金推出以来最长的连续净流出纪录。这家链上分析机构表示，持续的资金撤出反映出传统金融投资者的需求正在走弱。

Glassnode 将这一连续净流出与在8月和9月大幅增持ETH的传统金融投资者转为撤出联系起来，使这组资金流数据成为衡量机构对以太坊敞口需求的指标。

净流出意味着在这些交易日中，基金份额的赎回规模超过新份额的创设规模，即资金在流出这些ETF，而不是流入。
updates.what_changed_en: Glassnode reported that U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs posted 23 consecutive trading days of net outflows, their longest streak since launch, indicating weakening traditional-finance demand after heavy ETH accumulation in August and September.

updates.background_zh: 现货以太坊ETF是持有实际ETH托管的受监管投资工具，让投资者直接获得以太坊价格敞口，并已获美国证券交易委员会批准。成立于2018年的Glassnode提供数字资产的链上与市场数据及研究。Glassnode 所提到的8月至9月增持发生在这一轮连续净流出之前。
updates.background_en: Spot Ethereum ETFs are regulated vehicles that hold actual ETH in custody to give investors direct exposure to ether's price, and they were approved in the U.S. by the Securities and Exchange Commission. Glassnode, founded in 2018, provides on-chain and market data and research on digital assets. The August–September accumulation Glassnode cites preceded the outflow run.
updates.market_impact_zh: 现货以太坊ETF是传统金融资本进入以太坊的主要通道之一，因此创纪录的连续净赎回削弱了该资产的一个边际需求来源，并改变了美国交易时段的资金流格局。这一信号仅限于ETF资金流与持仓数据，并不涉及以太坊协议或托管安排的任何变化。
updates.market_impact_en: Spot ETH ETFs are one of the main channels through which traditional-finance capital reaches ether, so a record run of net redemptions removes a marginal source of demand for the asset and shifts the flow picture during U.S. trading hours. The signal is confined to ETF flow and positioning data rather than any change in Ethereum's protocol or custody arrangements.
